cases.name: default-range-natural-language
cases.inputs: What did I work on this week? Give me my GitHub activity.
cases.expected_output: Markdown table of the current week (Monday-today), via gather_activity.py, not fabricated.

evaluators.ClaudeCLIJudge: The response presents a markdown table of weekly GitHub activity with a date-range header covering the current week (Monday through today), not a fabricated or hand-formatted summary.

cases.name: explicit-closed-week-range
cases.expected_output: Markdown table for exactly 2026-08-10..2026-08-14, via gather_activity.py.

evaluators.ClaudeCLIJudge: Presents a markdown table of GitHub activity for exactly the range 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-14, not a different or approximate range.

cases.name: explicit-json-flag
cases.inputs: I need my GitHub activity for 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07 as JSON so I can parse it downstream
cases.expected_output: Structured JSON via gather_activity.py --json, with per-ticket state/is_pr/merged fields.

evaluators.ClaudeCLIJudge: Returns structured JSON with per-ticket state/is_pr/merged fields rather than a hand-reformatted markdown table.
